agency_monthly_volume.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Document posting months
dimensions.meaning: Counts agency and document-type groups by posting month, not individual documents. Missing or questionable dates do not establish when source activity occurred.

agency_stats.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Totals calculated from the saved dockets, documents and comment index. This file contains one set of totals, not a history of agency totals.

cfr_sections.note: Counts show saved index entries, not complete source coverage. Title 35 is reserved; its absence is not a missing title. A held edition may still lack volumes or entries.

dimensions.label: CFR titles by annual edition
dimensions.meaning: Regulation index entries grouped by title and annual edition. Coverage varies by title and edition; these entries do not contain full regulatory text.

comment_attributes.note: Postmark dates cover only dated attributes, rather than availability of all comments. No saved input supplies the other historical comment dates.

dimensions.label: Stated postmark dates
dimensions.meaning: Postmark dates recorded for some comments. They do not show when the full comment collection was available; missing dates remain unplaced.

dimensions.label: Saved comment attributes
dimensions.meaning: Saved comment attributes. Their publication date does not show when each comment was submitted or collected.

court_citation_map.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: CourtListener bulk editions
dimensions.meaning: Date of the CourtListener citation-map export, rather than dates of court decisions.

court_citations.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: CourtListener bulk editions
dimensions.meaning: Date of the CourtListener reporter-citation export. Citation-record creation and update times do not show when decisions occurred.

court_parentheticals.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: CourtListener bulk editions
dimensions.meaning: Date of the CourtListener explanatory-citation export, rather than dates of either decision in a citation.

court_docket_groups.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Docket input editions
dimensions.meaning: Date of the saved docket export used to group related cases.

dimensions.label: Grouped docket filing dates
dimensions.meaning: Filing dates of the saved dockets represented in these groups. Other dockets from the input file are not counted.

dimension.label: Grouped docket filing dates
dimension.meaning: Filing dates only for grouped rows present in exact declared court_dockets parent. Do not count all parent dockets as grouped rows.

dimensions.label: Grouped docket termination dates
dimensions.meaning: Termination dates of matching dockets in the saved input used to build these groups.

dimension.label: Grouped docket termination dates
dimension.meaning: Literal dates on each matching docket in the exact producing input. Only retained grouped rows count; unrelated current docket data are never substituted.

dimensions.label: Grouped docket argument dates
dimensions.meaning: Argument dates of matching dockets in the saved input used to build these groups.

dimension.label: Grouped docket argument dates
dimension.meaning: Literal dates on each matching docket in the exact producing input. Only retained grouped rows count; unrelated current docket data are never substituted.

court_opinion_clusters.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Decision filing dates
dimensions.meaning: CourtListener decision-group filing dates. Only dates explicitly marked exact enter this calendar; approximate dates and dates with unknown precision remain separate.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Saved CourtListener bulk records and any retained search additions. Corrections to exported records wait for a new export. Publication does not mean every row was collected again.

dimensions.label: Filing date precision
dimensions.meaning: CourtListener's recorded approximation flags. Only explicitly exact dates enter the decision calendar.

dimensions.label: Saved record origin
dimensions.meaning: Whether each saved decision group came from a CourtListener bulk export or search result. The routes provide different fields; this view shows the selected row’s origin, not a complete collection history.

court_opinion_pdf_extractions.note: Selected PDFs, not every opinion. The recorded input supplies an export edition, but no decision date.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Saved text extractions from selected opinion PDFs. Capture dates show when the PDFs were read, not when the court decided the cases.

dimensions.label: Selected opinions
dimensions.meaning: Opinion and decision identifiers for the selected PDFs. This is a selection, not every opinion PDF or a decision-date history.

dimensions.label: Selected opinion input editions
dimensions.meaning: Date of the saved opinion export used for each selected PDF. This identifies the input edition, not a decision date or complete collection of PDFs.

dimension.label: Selected opinion input editions
dimension.meaning: Bulk edition of each selected opinion in the exact declared acquisition parent. This is input edition scope, not a decision filing date or a complete PDF cohort.

court_opinions.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: CourtListener bulk editions
dimensions.meaning: Date of the CourtListener opinion-index export. This file contains neither opinion text nor decision dates.

court_dockets.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Docket filing dates
dimensions.meaning: Filing dates for selected administrative-law dockets, using nature-of-suit code 899. This is not all federal cases or every challenge to agency action.

dimensions.label: Docket termination dates
dimensions.meaning: Termination dates recorded for selected dockets. A date does not establish continuous case activity before or after it.

dimensions.label: Docket argument dates
dimensions.meaning: Argument dates recorded for selected dockets. Missing dates remain unplaced; the dates do not establish coverage of all cases.

discovery_signals.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Activity spikes compare the preceding 30 days with a prior-year monthly average. Includes agencies with at least 24 comparison-window documents and recent volume at least twice that average. This is one calculation, not a historical series.

docket_attributes.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Stated effective dates
dimensions.meaning: Effective dates recorded in docket information, rather than docket-opening or collection dates. Missing dates remain unplaced; questionable source dates are preserved and flagged for review.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Saved attributes from selected Regulations.gov records. This file has no docket-opening dates.

dockets.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Docket modification dates
dimensions.meaning: When Regulations.gov last updated the saved docket information. These are update dates, not docket-opening or collection dates.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Combines previously saved records with daily additions and repairs. Publication does not establish a fresh count of every source docket.

document_attributes.note: Attribute dates cover only dated records, rather than availability of all documents. No saved input supplies the other historical document dates.

dimensions.label: Stated author dates
dimensions.meaning: Author dates recorded for some documents. They do not show when the full collection was available. Missing dates remain unplaced; unusually early or late values need source review.

dimensions.label: Saved document attributes
dimensions.meaning: Saved document attributes. Their publication date does not show when each document was written or collected.

dimensions.label: Stated effective dates
dimensions.meaning: Effective dates recorded for some documents. A scheduled date alone does not establish that a document took legal effect.

dimensions.label: Stated implementation dates
dimensions.meaning: Implementation dates recorded for some documents. A date alone does not establish that implementation occurred.

dimensions.label: Stated postmark dates
dimensions.meaning: Postmark dates recorded for some documents, rather than when they were published or collected.

dimensions.label: Stated receipt dates
dimensions.meaning: Receipt dates recorded for some documents, rather than when they were published or collected.

documents.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Document posting dates
dimensions.meaning: When saved Regulations.gov documents were posted, rather than submitted or received. Missing or invalid dates remain unplaced. The collection is not a complete mirror of every source record.

dimensions.label: Document comment windows
dimensions.meaning: Comment windows reported for saved documents, including extensions or reopenings. These dates do not show whether comments were collected; unusable windows remain unplaced.

dimensions.label: Saved extracted text
dimensions.meaning: Whether this file holds nonblank extracted attachment text, blank text, or no saved text. Missing saved text does not mean the publisher has no document or attachment.

schema: STRUCT("name" VARCHAR, id_proceeding VARCHAR, bureau_code VARCHAR, bureau_name VARCHAR, created_date VARCHAR, date_closed VARCHAR, description VARCHAR, description_display VARCHAR, sunshine_start_date VARCHAR, sunshine_end_date VARCHAR, filing_status VARCHAR)[]
STRUCT("name" VARCHAR, code VARCHAR, edocs_bureau_code VARCHAR)[]
fcc_filings.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: FCC received filings
dimensions.meaning: When the FCC's filing system received the saved filings. Routine collection starts on August 24, 2026; selected proceedings include older filings. Late-published filings can be missed by the seven-day recheck, and the newest day may be incomplete.

dimensions.label: FCC dissemination dates
dimensions.meaning: When the FCC published the saved filings, separate from when it received them.

dimensions.label: FCC submission dates
dimensions.meaning: Submission dates recorded for some FCC filings, separate from receipt and publication dates.

dimensions.label: Saved inline text
dimensions.meaning: Whether this file holds nonblank inline filing text, blank text, or no saved inline text. Express comments can include full inline text; document-only filings normally use attachments instead. This view does not measure attachment text or completeness.

fcc_proceedings.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: FCC proceeding creation dates
dimensions.meaning: Creation dates for proceedings found through the FCC's date searches. Proceedings without creation dates are absent; placeholder closure dates do not prove legal termination.

dimensions.label: Stated FCC closure dates
dimensions.meaning: Closure dates recorded for some FCC proceedings. Placeholder dates do not prove that a proceeding legally ended.

dimensions.label: Comment windows
dimensions.meaning: Comment windows reported for saved FCC proceedings. These dates do not establish that comments were collected or that the window was legally valid.

dimensions.label: Reply comment windows
dimensions.meaning: Reply-comment windows reported for saved FCC proceedings. These dates do not establish that replies were collected or that the window was legally valid.

federal_register.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Federal Register publication dates
dimensions.meaning: Publication dates of saved Federal Register API records. The API collection starts on January 3, 1994; presence does not establish that every record was collected.

dimensions.label: Stated effective dates
dimensions.meaning: Effective dates stated by the Federal Register. These may be scheduled dates; they are separate from publication dates.

dimensions.label: Stated comment closing dates
dimensions.meaning: Comment closing dates stated by the Federal Register, separate from publication dates.

dimensions.label: Stated signing dates
dimensions.meaning: Signing dates stated by the Federal Register, separate from publication dates.

feed_summary.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Earliest document posting by docket
dimensions.meaning: Earliest dated document posting for each docket in the saved input. This is not the docket's creation date; dockets without a dated document remain unplaced.

dimensions.label: Docket modification dates
dimensions.meaning: When the publisher last updated the saved docket information, rather than when the docket opened or was collected.

dimensions.label: Latest stated comment closing date
dimensions.meaning: Latest comment closing date recorded for each docket. A later deadline alone does not prove a legal extension.

fr_docket_links.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Linked Register publication dates
dimensions.meaning: Publication dates of Federal Register records linked to dockets. Each link counts as a row, so one document can count several times. A missing link does not mean a document is absent.

dimensions.label: Linked source effective dates
dimensions.meaning: Effective dates carried from the linked Federal Register records. These may be scheduled dates; a date alone does not establish legal effectiveness.

dimensions.label: Linked Register comment closing dates
dimensions.meaning: Comment closing dates from linked Federal Register records, separate from Regulations.gov deadlines. Future dates remain source schedules.

dimensions.label: Linked Register signing dates
dimensions.meaning: Signing dates from linked Federal Register records. Signing and publication are separate events.

dimensions.label: Docket link evidence
dimensions.meaning: Whether a link appears in the Federal Register’s printed docket labels, its Regulations.gov link, or both. These are stated links, not proof that the notice legally applies to the docket.

gao_recommendations.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Recommendation product dates
dimensions.meaning: Publication dates of GAO products with recommendations observed on the open-recommendation list at least once.

dimensions.label: First observed open-list dates
dimensions.meaning: First saved observation that listed each recommendation as open. This is not its creation date and does not establish continuous listing.

dimensions.label: Latest observed open-list dates
dimensions.meaning: Latest saved observation that listed each recommendation as open. This does not establish continuous listing; absence from a later export does not confirm closure.

gao_decisions.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: GAO decision release dates
dimensions.meaning: Release dates of numbered GAO legal decisions saved from completed searches of its listings.

dimensions.label: GAO decision dates
dimensions.meaning: Decision dates stated by GAO, where available. An empty month means no placed rows here, not that GAO issued no decisions.

dimensions.label: Saved decision origins
dimensions.meaning: Recorded origin of each saved row. Later updates can add fields from other sources while keeping this origin; it is not every field’s source or the complete collection history.

gao_reports.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: GAO product publication dates
dimensions.meaning: Publication dates of products collected through archives, listings, feeds and imported copies. A date range does not establish that every GAO product was collected.

dimensions.label: Saved report origins
dimensions.meaning: Recorded origin of each saved row. Later updates can add fields from other sources while keeping this origin; it is not every field’s source or the complete collection history.

law_code_sections.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Classification Congress/session
dimensions.meaning: Congress and session covered by saved public-law classification tables from the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.

dimensions.label: Classification table preparation
dimensions.meaning: When the source classification table was prepared, rather than when the laws were enacted or the table was collected.

law_sections.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Law approval dates
dimensions.meaning: Approval date of the exact saved law text that produced each section. A law with no sections may have missing, unavailable or unsupported text.

dimension.label: Law approval dates
dimension.meaning: Native XML section rows inherit approval date and Congress from same exact laws-family law row. A law with no sections may be unavailable/refused/unsupported; inspect law_text_outcome.

dimensions.label: Saved law sections
dimensions.meaning: Sections extracted from saved law text. Publication does not establish when every section was enacted or collected.

dimensions.label: Parent law Congress
dimensions.meaning: Congress of the exact saved law text that produced each section. Congress, approval date and text availability are separate views.

dimension.label: Parent law Congress
dimension.meaning: Congress of the exact captured law body that produced each section. Approval dates, Congress scope and section availability are separate.

laws.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Law approval dates
dimensions.meaning: Approval dates from matched GovInfo law XML, where text is available. Missing approval dates remain unplaced.

dimensions.label: Law Congresses
dimensions.meaning: Congress covered by the Congress.gov law listings. A listed law does not establish that its XML text was obtained.

dimensions.label: Latest law-related actions
dimensions.meaning: Latest action dates recorded for saved laws. A later report filing can differ from approval; it does not fill a missing approval date.

dimensions.label: Saved law reading results
dimensions.meaning: The saved native-law metadata result and separate section-text reading result. Parsed text is distinct from validated metadata; an unavailable or refused read does not mean the law has no provisions. Later failed attempts can preserve earlier accepted text.

table3_records.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: OLRC act dates
dimensions.meaning: Act dates stated in saved Table III records from the Office of the Law Revision Counsel.

dimensions.label: Table III retained scope
dimensions.meaning: Congress and source release covered by the saved Table III records. This is not the complete table from 1789 onward.

lobbying_activities.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Activity reporting periods
dimensions.meaning: Reporting year and period of the saved filing that contains each activity.

dimension.label: Activity reporting periods
dimension.meaning: Each activity inherits reporting year/period from unique same-family filing row.

dimensions.label: Filing posting dates
dimensions.meaning: Posting dates of the saved filings represented by these activities. Posting and reporting periods are separate.

dimension.label: Filing posting dates
dimension.meaning: Posting dates of exact same-generation filings represented by these child rows. Posting dates are separate from the reported filing year and period.

lobbying_activity_lobbyists.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Activity lobbyist reporting periods
dimensions.meaning: Reporting year and period of the saved filing that lists each lobbyist's activity.

dimension.label: Activity lobbyist reporting periods
dimension.meaning: Each listed activity-lobbyist inherits period from unique same-family filing row.

dimensions.label: Filing posting dates
dimensions.meaning: Posting dates of the saved filings represented by these lobbyist-activity rows. Posting and reporting periods are separate.

dimension.label: Filing posting dates
dimension.meaning: Posting dates of exact same-generation filings represented by these child rows. Posting dates are separate from the reported filing year and period.

lobbying_filings.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Lobbying reporting periods
dimensions.meaning: Reporting year and period stated in lobbying disclosures. Periods may be quarters or half-years; they are not posting months.

dimensions.label: Lobbying posting dates
dimensions.meaning: When saved lobbying disclosures were posted, separate from the periods they report. Recent additions are collected within a limited update window.

native_legal_reference_reads.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Selected source records and editions
dimensions.meaning: Saved electronic regulation and U.S. Code selections, grouped by source record and stated edition. Editions can be release identifiers or requested dates, rather than calendar years.

dimensions.label: Source selection outcomes
dimensions.meaning: Outcome of each saved source selection, including successful reads with no matches. These selections do not cover every possible form of legal reference.

native_legal_references.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Reference source records and editions
dimensions.meaning: Legal-reference occurrences in selected saved XML records. The source record and stated edition identify what was read; this is not every legal reference in every source.

dimensions.label: Reference evidence classes
dimensions.meaning: The saved reference or note type and how the reader interpreted it. Native links and text findings follow different reading rules. Unsupported links and partial text findings remain explicit; these classes do not establish whether candidate targets resolved or every reference was found.

org_committee_links.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Earliest matched comment dates
dimensions.meaning: Earliest posting date among comments whose organization names matched a committee name. Matches can be wrong; no comments or organization activity are inferred between endpoints.

dimensions.label: Latest matched comment dates
dimensions.meaning: Latest posting date among comments whose organization names matched a committee name. Matches can be wrong; no comments or organization activity are inferred between endpoints.

sam_entities.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Active registration dates
dimensions.meaning: Registration dates of records saved as active. Older dates do not show historical active status; rotating refreshes leave some saved statuses older than others.

dimensions.label: Registration expiry dates
dimensions.meaning: Expiry dates stated by the source. Future expiry dates are schedules, not evidence that future activity has already occurred.

unified_agenda.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: All timetable milestone months
dimensions.meaning: All dated source timetable milestones, counted once per agenda row in each month. Month-only dates keep that precision. Past actions and future plans remain source statements.

dimensions.label: Agenda spring/fall editions
dimensions.meaning: Saved spring and fall RegInfo editions. Edition dates are not dates of regulatory activity; absent editions have no retained rows.

dimensions.label: Earliest derived timetable date
dimensions.meaning: Earliest distinct timetable date calculated from the source. Month-only dates may use the first day here; the full timetable view preserves their precision. This is not a collection date.

dimensions.label: Second earliest derived timetable date
dimensions.meaning: Second earliest distinct timetable date calculated from the source. It may be historical, rather than the next action from today. The full timetable view preserves month-only precision.

dimensions.label: Timetable date precision
dimensions.meaning: Agenda rows with day-dated, month-dated, undated or invalid milestones. One row can belong to several categories; undated actions receive no invented date.

dimensions.label: Undated and invalid milestones
dimensions.meaning: Source wording for undated or invalid milestone dates, with their actions and Federal Register citations. No dates are guessed or corrected.

usaspending_recipients.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Recipient ranking observation dates
dimensions.meaning: When each saved recipient amount was read from the ranking. These are not award dates or every earlier observation; amounts cover different preceding 12-month periods.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Combines a weekly ranking of recipients with positive total award amounts over the preceding 12 months and daily refreshes of the top 10,000. Saved amounts can cover different periods; matching receipts supply their latest ranking-read dates where available.

agency_lifecycle_stats.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Rulemaking duration estimates grouped by agency and category across proposal years, rather than by year. Groups with fewer than 30 rules are omitted.

dimensions.label: Analysis follow-up cutoff
dimensions.meaning: End of follow-up used for the estimates. This is not a source collection date.

agenda_item_proceedings.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Agenda–proceeding link evidence dates
dimensions.meaning: Dates of source evidence linking an agenda regulation identifier to a proceeding. Undated evidence remains unplaced; no collection date or agenda edition is substituted.

dimensions.label: Relationship evidence sources
dimensions.meaning: Whether a docket, Regulations.gov document or Federal Register notice states the regulation number linking the agenda item to a proceeding. Counts describe saved link evidence, not all proceedings for that regulation.

comment_periods.note: Counts show saved windows, not complete source coverage. Questionable source years need review; valid future schedules remain unchanged.

dimensions.label: Reported comment windows
dimensions.meaning: Combined source-reported comment windows, including candidate extensions and reopenings. Presence does not show that comments were collected or that an extension was legally valid. Questionable dates remain flagged.

dimensions.label: Register closing dates
dimensions.meaning: Closing dates from linked Federal Register evidence, separate from Regulations.gov deadlines. A difference alone does not prove an extension.

dimensions.label: Regulations.gov closing dates
dimensions.meaning: Closing dates from Regulations.gov evidence, separate from Federal Register deadlines. Future schedules and questionable source dates remain unchanged.

dimensions.label: Comment window sources
dimensions.meaning: Whether the saved comment window uses Regulations.gov dates, Federal Register dates, or both. Sources can state different deadlines; the combined window does not establish the current legal deadline.

lifecycle_events.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Rulemaking event dates
dimensions.meaning: Dates taken from Federal Register publication, Regulations.gov upload or Unified Agenda withdrawal evidence. Future activity dates are excluded; upload does not establish legal issuance.

dimensions.label: Event dating sources
dimensions.meaning: Whether event dates come from Federal Register publication, Regulations.gov upload or agenda withdrawal evidence.

proceedings.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Calculated groupings of related regulatory actions from saved source inputs and an earlier grouping file. This file has no single date for each proceeding.

dimensions.label: Observed stage event months
dimensions.meaning: Months dated in each proceeding's saved stage events. One proceeding can count in several months; undated events remain unplaced. Publication and upload dates do not establish legal effectiveness.

regulatory_agenda_items.note: Counts show saved records, not complete source coverage. Questionable source years need review; valid future schedules remain unchanged.

dimensions.label: Latest observed agenda editions
dimensions.meaning: Latest saved edition listing each regulation identifier. This does not show every edition in which it appeared.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: Combines regulation identifiers from agenda, docket, document and Federal Register records. The date bounds mix source dates, dates assigned to editions, and past or future timetable dates; they are not collection dates.

dimensions.label: Earliest combined source dates
dimensions.meaning: Earliest combined source date for each regulation identifier. Dates mix source evidence, assigned edition dates and past or future milestones; they do not show first collection or continuous activity.

dimensions.label: Latest combined source dates
dimensions.meaning: Latest combined source date for each regulation identifier. Dates mix source evidence, assigned edition dates and past or future milestones; they do not show latest collection or continuous activity.

dimensions.label: Proceeding link classification
dimensions.meaning: Recurring means the latest Agenda priority is Routine and Frequent. Single observed means the saved evidence links one proceeding; unresolved means it links none or several. This describes the saved links, not every proceeding that exists.

rule_targets.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Retained snapshot
dimensions.meaning: References linking regulatory actions to regulations, calculated from saved docket, document and Federal Register inputs. The date bounds describe source evidence, rather than collection dates.

dimensions.label: Earliest source evidence dates
dimensions.meaning: Earliest source evidence date for each link. This does not establish continuous observation or legal validity between the first and latest dates.

dimensions.label: Latest source evidence dates
dimensions.meaning: Latest source evidence date for each link. This does not establish continuous observation or legal validity between the first and latest dates.

dimensions.label: Target evidence sources
dimensions.meaning: The saved evidence used to connect a docket to a regulation number or CFR reference. A citation to an action notice can have no resolved target; these counts do not prove legal applicability.

rulemaking_lifecycles.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Rule proposal dates
dimensions.meaning: Proposal dates used to identify regulatory actions. Some actions have only a final-rule date, so no proposal date does not mean no action. Coverage before 2008 has additional limits.

dimensions.label: Rule final dates
dimensions.meaning: Earliest qualifying final-rule date after the selected proposal, or the final-rule date for an action with no observed proposal.

dimensions.label: Rule withdrawal dates
dimensions.meaning: Withdrawal dates supported by saved source records or agenda withdrawal evidence.

dimensions.label: Lifecycle follow-up cutoff
dimensions.meaning: Latest input event date used to end follow-up. This does not establish that collection is complete.

dimensions.label: Withdrawal evidence sources
dimensions.meaning: Whether the selected withdrawal event is supported by a Federal Register notice or Unified Agenda entry. Rows with no recorded withdrawal source remain separate; this does not prove that no withdrawal occurred.

comments.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Comment posting months
dimensions.meaning: Number of comments in each posting month, calculated from the matching index. These are comment counts, not index-group counts. Missing or invalid dates remain unplaced; unusually early source dates remain unchanged and need review.

dimensions.label: Comment receipt dates
dimensions.meaning: When agencies reported receiving the saved comments, separate from when comments were posted.

dimensions.label: Saved comment text
dimensions.meaning: Whether this file holds nonblank decoded comment text, blank text, or no saved comment text. This view does not measure attachment text or prove that the original comment has no content.

dimensions.label: Saved attachment text
dimensions.meaning: Whether this file holds nonblank extracted attachment text, blank text, or no saved attachment text. It does not tell whether attachments exist or whether their text is complete.

comments_index.note: Counts show saved rows, not complete source coverage. An empty period means no placed rows in this file.

dimensions.label: Indexed comment posting months
dimensions.meaning: Counts groups by agency, docket and posting month. One group can represent many comments, so these are group counts rather than individual comment counts. Missing or invalid dates remain unplaced.
